thread:
Sara: Kicking off staged rollout to EU: model inference-model v2.3.1 -> 10% (eu-west, eu-central). Change window 22:00-02:00 UTC. Release notes: https://go.redwood/rn/v2.3.1. Monitoring latency, embeddings, and kv-cache metrics. @Raj you have signal.

DeployBot: rollout started r-1747077777: canary -> 10% traffic. Health checks passing. autoscale=on. (ID r-1747077777)

Raj: quick heads-up — small bump in p99 latency for /embed endpoint in eu-west, ~+120ms on a 1k sample. Not sure if noise yet.

Mike: pulling traces. looks concentrated to a handful of hosts, kvcache eviction spikes on node group eu-west-a.

DeployBot: alert: host i-0a1b2c3d exceeded kvcache-eviction-threshold in eu-west-1. Marking for drain and rotation.

Elaine: if drains aren't clean, plan B is to pin eu-west to v2.3.0 until we triage. Can we patch routing rule quickly if needed?

Sara: pausing rollout at 10% while we confirm infra. @DeployBot pause r-1747077777

DeployBot: rollout r-1747077777 paused by Sara at 1747077795. Current traffic remains at 10%. No further shifts scheduled.

Mike: rebooted the misbehaving host and applied kernel patch. kvcache eviction rate back to baseline across the group.

Raj: metrics: p99 back to baseline, errors unchanged. embedding quality eval: cosine drift 0.17% on eval set (within threshold). Recommend resuming ramp after 5m observation.

Sara: agree. resume to 30% after 5m observation window. @DeployBot resume r-1747077777 target=30% ramp=3m

DeployBot: resuming rollout r-1747077777 -> target 30% over 3m. Next automated status update at 1747077860.

Elaine: :thumbsup: infra watchers will stand by for the window. If any regression, route pin/backfill plan ready. Release note snippet attached in the ticket.
